## About {.unnumbered}

This is the homepage of the course. The content is organised into **modules**, each comprising a series of **lectures** accessible through dedicated pages.

On each lecture page, you'll find:

- AI-assisted **video presentation** of the lecture  
- Accompanying **lecture notes** for review and reference

You are encouraged to engage with the material at your own pace - whether by watching the videos, reading the notes, or both.

We hope you enjoy the learning experience.  
**Happy learning!**
